title: Appwrite: add Sign Language (sgn) to locale API
description:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/appwrite/appwrite/issues/8201

Need a contributor to implement Appwrite issue #8201: add Sign Language (`sgn`) to the locale API language list.

Scope:
- Find where Appwrite defines supported locale languages
- Add the `sgn` entry with the expected fields
- Update any affected tests, fixtures, or generated data
- Verify the locale API returns the new entry correctly

Deliverables:
- A GitHub PR against `appwrite/appwrite`
- Short implementation notes describing files changed
- Test evidence or commands run
- Link to the upstream issue and PR in your final submission

Quality bar:
- Keep the change minimal and aligned with existing locale-data conventions
- Do not introduce unrelated refactors
- If maintainers prefer a different code location or format, adapt and document it in the PR

Nice to have:
- If documentation or changelog updates are clearly expected by the repo, include them

Submission should include:
- PR URL
- Commit hash
- Brief test summary
